dimensions.evidence: All four requirements verified by executable checks: t1.api.delete-204-removes (204 on success), t1.api.delete-missing-404 (404 on missing), t1.db.only-target-removed (single-row deletion), t1.ui.row-delete-no-reload (no page reload). Capability matrix present with 1.0 coverage; verifiability-matrix.md defines api:item-lifecycle method covering the full delete lifecycle. Runtime evidence: app_launched=true, capability_matrix_coverage=1.0.

API endpoint follows existing FastAPI pattern in api/app/main.py (HTTPException error mapping). Service layer adds delete_item() mirroring add_item() pattern. Repository seam properly respected: delete_item() method added to IWriteItemRepository protocol, implemented in WriteItemRepository with SQLAlchemy Session. Domain error ItemNotFoundError defined in wts_persistence/domain/errors.py and raised before DB layer (correct boundary). Web UI state management consistent with add-item pattern (deletingIds Set, fetch, state update). No SQL written outside persistence layer (verified by t1.structural.seam).
Task requests feature addition only; no structural change requested.

API contracts: DELETE returns 204 with empty body (success) and 404 (not found) — REST standard, consistent with CREATE returning 201. Domain error ItemNotFoundError raised when session.get(ItemEntity, item_id) returns None, propagates through service to API layer, caught and mapped to HTTPException(status_code=404). Repository protocol delete_item(item_id: int) -> None defined in IWriteItemRepository and implemented. Web: fetch DELETE, checks res.ok, updates items list on 204, re-fetches on error. No boundary inconsistencies.

No defects found. Exception handling correct: ItemNotFoundError raised inside try block but not caught by SQLAlchemyError handler — propagates as intended (correct pattern). React state management: deletingIds Set properly tracks in-flight deletes, button disabled during delete, re-fetches on error. Regression checks pass (reg.items-create-list, reg.ui-lists-items, reg.api-health, reg.api-boots-health-ok, reg.worker-writes-rows, reg.web-typecheck-build), confirming existing functionality intact.

No test suite disabled or weakened. Verification documentation added (verifiability-matrix.md, verify_item_api.sh) is appropriate and substantive. Commit messages are descriptive, not reviewer-directed or self-congratulatory. README and architecture prose updated to reflect delete capability (not a violation; proper documentation maintenance).

Branch cohesion: 1.0 (consistent naming across repos). Commits properly formatted: (1) 'feat(winter-test-service): allow deleting items' — conventional scope, clear description, explains implementation path and verification approach; (2) 'docs(winter-test-service): reconcile README and verification docs with delete' — docs() scope, explains rationale (stale Architecture prose, harness review findings on auto-reload). Both commits focused and well-scoped. Delivery metadata shows cohesion=1.0.
